entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A dragon-obsessed Planeswalker born on Tarkir who travels back in time through the Nexus, saves Ugin from death and changes Tarkir's history; he was never born in the new timeline.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Sarkhan's homeworld, home to five khans and clans in one timeline and to dragonlords in the rewritten one.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An elder dragon Planeswalker who helped imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar; in the original timeline he is a ghost and bones, in the new one he lives in a hedron cocoon.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon Planeswalker and Sarkhan's hated foe who fights and strikes down Ugin in Tarkir's past and is involved in the Eldrazi's release.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire Planeswalker of Innistrad who seeks Ugin's help against the Eldrazi, and in the new timeline awakens him.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A kor Planeswalker called the Lithomancer who used Zendikar as a cage to imprison the Eldrazi titans.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: The Jeskai khan who dies at Zurgo's hands in the original timeline, and a Planeswalker exile in the new one who recognizes Sarkhan.

entities.name: Zurgo Helmsmasher
entities.description: The Mardu khan and Sarkhan's enemy who kills Narset in the original timeline; in the new one he is Kolaghan's herald and bell-striker.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: The ancient Temur khan who meets Sarkhan in Tarkir's past and unwittingly helps Bolas defeat Ugin.

entities.name: Surrak Dragonclaw
entities.description: The Temur khan in the original timeline and Hunt Caller of the Atarka clan in the new one.

entities.name: Taigam
entities.description: The Sultai khan's enforcer in the original timeline and an Ojutai monk in the new one.

entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: A naga who is Sultai khan in the original timeline and an executed zombie servant of the dragonlord in the new one.

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: Khan of the Abzan in the original timeline; her fate is less kind in the new one.

entities.name: Alesha
entities.description: Young khan of the ancient Mardu who fights dragons with her horde.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: The vain child-khan of the ancient Sultai who bargains with Silumgar and betrays the khans.

entities.name: Daghatar
entities.description: The ancient Abzan khan who destroys the Remembrance and pledges his clan to Dromoka.

entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: The ancient Jeskai khan who convenes the khans and offers his life to Ojutai to spare his clan.

entities.name: Reyhan
entities.description: The khan of the remaining free Abzan, who dies securing an escape for Yasova and Alesha.

entities.name: Quan
entities.description: Shu Yun's scribe, who records the khans' meeting.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A dragon seen asserting dominance over her new broodlings in Tarkir's past, later a dragonlord.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A dragon who accepts Tasigur's bargain and leads an assault on Dirgur Stronghold.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A dragon who assaults Dirgur Stronghold and accepts Shu Yun's terms.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: A dragon whose organized brood forces Daghatar to abandon ancestor worship.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: A dragonlord whose skull was the Mardu khan's throne in the original timeline.

entities.name: Vial Smasher
entities.description: A goblin Sarkhan recognizes as Ankle Shanker, who does not recognize him.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Monstrous beings, including the titans Emrakul, Ulamog and Kozilek, imprisoned on Zendikar and since freed.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane, used as a cage to imprison the Eldrazi titans.

entities.name: The Nexus
entities.description: The tomb of the Spirit Dragon, a canyon with a vortex of energy and a gate through time.

entities.name: Dirgur Stronghold
entities.description: The Jeskai stronghold where the five khans meet and are attacked by dragons.

entities.name: The Remembrance
entities.description: A mace imbued with the ancestor spirits of countless fallen Abzan.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: A spiritual clan of Tarkir led by a khan.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir that emphasizes speed.

entities.name: Abzan
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir that believes in endurance.

entities.name: Jeskai
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir that is led by Narset in the original timeline and does not exist in the new one.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A clan of Tarkir ruled by khans and puppetmaster rakshasa.

events.summary: Sarkhan arrives on Tarkir, recalls his past and the ghost of Ugin urges him to find the doorway; he sets out for the mountains.
events.quote: who urges him to "find the doorway."

events.summary: Sorin fights through Temur hunters, makes a vampire guide and finds Ugin dead in the canyon, concluding the Multiverse is doomed.
events.quote: Ugin is long since dead, and Sorin concludes that the Multiverse is doomed.

events.summary: Six thousand years earlier, Nahiri and Sorin fail to save an unknown plane from the Eldrazi, then agree with Ugin to imprison the titans on Zendikar.
events.quote: The trap is sprung, the titans are subdued, and Nahiri settles in for a long vigil to keep them imprisoned.

events.summary: Zurgo, mad with rage after his Mardu refuse to follow his personal quest, kills the challenger and leaves alone to hunt Sarkhan.
events.quote: Zurgo's command is challenged, and he kills the challenger

events.summary: Narset leads Sarkhan to the Nexus and stays to hold off Zurgo, who kills her; Sarkhan swears vengeance and steps through the gate.
Sarkhan emerges in Tarkir's past, sees Atarka and Yasova, and realizes he has traveled back in time.
events.quote: He realizes the truth: he has traveled into Tarkir's past

events.summary: Yasova tells Sarkhan she follows a vision given by Bolas, and Sarkhan transforms into a dragon and flies off.
events.quote: Sarkhan transforms into a dragon and flies away.

events.summary: Bolas strikes down Ugin, Sarkhan wraps Ugin in a hedron cocoon, and is whisked back to an altered present; the dragon tempests intensify.
events.quote: Bolas strikes Ugin down as Sarkhan tumbles into the snow.

events.summary: Tasigur seeks out the dragon Silumgar and offers his allegiance for the dragon's help.
events.quote: his allegiance for the dragon's assistance.

events.summary: Daghatar destroys the Remembrance and pledges his clan to Dromoka's service.
Dragons assault Dirgur Stronghold, Tasigur betrays the khans, Shu Yun offers his life to Ojutai, and Reyhan dies helping Yasova and Alesha escape; the clans fall.
events.quote: Reyhan dies during the fighting to secure an escape for Yasova and Alesha

events.summary: Sarkhan awakens in the altered present, unable to revive Ugin, and finds Kolaghan, Vial Smasher, Zurgo and Taigam changed and not knowing him.
Sorin, with no memory of an earlier visit, destroys the cocoon and awakens Ugin, who tells him the Eldrazi are free.
events.quote: Sorin destroys the cocoon and awakens Ugin.

events.summary: Ugin insists it must be the three of them, and Sorin agrees to find Nahiri and meet Ugin on Zendikar.
events.quote: Reluctantly, Sorin agrees to seek out Nahiri and meet Ugin on Zendikar to stop the Eldrazi.

events.summary: Sarkhan finds Ugin awake, learns he was never born in this timeline, and finds Narset, a Planeswalker exile; both are content to remain on Tarkir.
events.quote: both Planeswalkers agree that they are exactly where they wish to be.

relations.note: Zurgo hates Sarkhan and Sarkhan swears vengeance in return.
They fight in Tarkir's past and Bolas strikes Ugin down.
relations.quote: the titanic battle between a living Ugin and Nicol Bolas

relations.note: Sorin, Ugin and Nahiri imprisoned the Eldrazi together.
relations.quote: Sorin, Ugin, and a Planeswalker called the Lithomancer locked away the monstrous Eldrazi on Zendikar.

relations.note: Fought alongside Sorin; Ugin refers to a petty tiff between them.
relations.quote: fights alongside Sorin to defend an unknown plane

relations.note: Pledges himself and his clan to her service.
relations.quote: pledging himself and his clan to Dromoka's service.

relations.note: Offers his allegiance for the dragon's help.
relations.quote: his allegiance for the dragon's assistance.
now reduced to serving as Kolaghan's personal herald

relations.note: Sarkhan recognizes her as his friend.
relations.quote: He recognizes her as his friend Narset
